title: Xi visits Egypt as US sanctions threat looms over Iran links

article.title: Xi visits Egypt as US sanctions threat looms over Iran links
article.summary: BEIJING: Chinese Pres­ident Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt on Tuesday evening, making a rare trip to the Middle East as both countries face the threat of US sanctions over financial links to Iran. The months-long Middle East war, which began when the United States and Israel jointly launched strikes against Iran on February 28, has thrown the crucial trade region into crisis. Washington vowed last month to destabilise Teh­ran economically, warning of expanded sanctions against Tehran’s backers and partners that could hit Egyptian and Chinese banks, among others. Xi’s visit “comes at a time when China’s economic interests are directly exposed to the US-Iran war”, said Gamal Salama, political science professor at Egypt’s Suez University. China is “clearly seeking Egypt’s cooperation in managing and shaping regi­o­nal affairs”, said Liu Jia, a research fellow at the Singapore-based Mid­dle East Institute. Beijing works closely with regional actors such as Egypt, which mediates bet­ween Israel and Palestinian groups, Liu added.
